data.narrative:
Auterion is a Series B-stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security founded by Lorenz Meier and Kevin Sartori. The company has raised $130M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers at the same stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $130M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B to next-stage transitions, yielding $247M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables establishes a $1.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer cohort reflects meaningful dispersion, suggesting heterogeneous risk profiles or growth trajectories within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $210M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $624M. The wide spread reflects structural uncertainty inherent in early-stage defense-tech valuations: peer valuations span more than one order of magnitude, and stage-progression relies on sparse historical data for this sector. Key uncertainties include the company's relative technical maturity, addressable market penetration, and regulatory pathway clarity within defense procurement cycles. The median $624M estimate serves as a reasonable central anchor pending additional performance visibility.
